breakpoints.note: The harness directly feeds the entire staged witness into `readstat_parse_spss_commands`, so the input enters the SPSS command parser without any outer format or container dispatch.

breakpoints.code: double_quoted_string = "\"" ( [^"]* ) >{ str_start = fpc; } %{ str_len = fpc - str_start; } "\"";
breakpoints.note: First project-code parser action that materializes the attacker-controlled quoted value into the start pointer and length used by the vulnerable copy helper.

When the caller passes a 1024-byte quoted string into a 1024-byte destination, this branch leaves `this_len == buf_len == 1024`. The loop can therefore consume the entire destination, and the later terminator write has no in-bounds slot left. The missing obligation is the same one already implemented in `readstat_copy()`: cap at `buf_len - 1` before writing `\0`.
